integrity: Original analytic reasoning and a standard-library finite checker are included; earlier exponential zero-count principles and motivating physical modeling are credited.
scientific_limitations: Conditional three-positive-pathway exponential discharge-attenuation model; prescribed positive overspill factor and calibrated attenuation rates; no field calibration, noisy-threshold analysis, or independent audit. No claim that the source paper uses additive exponential pathways.
title: Sharp two-reversal and sign-only inversion laws for three-path estuarine salinity attenuation
